425:t_1:163.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you need something from us, $n?」

425:t_1:164.en:
$n
「I've finished my daily training. So I was thinking of getting someone to spar with me in a mock battle.」

425:t_1:165.en:
$$アルト$$
「I knew it. That's what this is about.」

425:t_1:166.en:
$n
「Tomorrow we launch a surprise attack on the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ that controls this whole area. Think of it as a warm-up.」

425:t_1:171.en:
$n
「That line doesn't suit you at all.」

425:t_1:172.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the last person who should say that.」

425:t_1:173.en:
$n
「I'll hand it right back to you.」

425:t_1:174.en:
$$カレン$$
「Bickering won't make you stronger, $n. If you want a sparring partner, I'll do it.」

425:t_1:175.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You do have a thing for him after all, don't you?」

425:t_1:177.en:
$n
「Then I can pound you without holding back.」

425:t_1:178.en:
$$カレン$$
「Big talk from a guy with an all-time head-to-head record of 12 wins and 46 losses.」

425:t_1:179.en:
$n
「I'll get my win count up to 20 today.」

425:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's continue that quarrel from before. After $$カレン$$, I'll take you on.」

425:t_1:181.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll do it too. I want to master the $$ユニコーン$$ better too, you know.」

425:t_1:183.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Looks like there was nothing to worry about.)

425:t_1:184.en:
$$アルト$$
(Maybe we were just overthinking it...)

425:t_2:3.en: ～ Facility Inside $$ターミナル・ベース$$ ～

425:t_2:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Only this one section differs from the structure of the other $$ターミナル・ベース$$s, so it seems to have been a place of some importance.」

425:t_2:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The structural strength of the block containing this facility is in a class of its own. That, too, hints at how special this place is.」

425:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So it's that strength that, conversely, spared it from the self-destruct damage?」

425:t_2:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Rushing their evacuation because of our surprise attack and lightning operation was likely a factor in the mistake, too.」

425:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「What's wrong, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

425:t_2:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I've seen a system similar to this in some documents.」

425:t_2:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$スピリチア$$ Farm Project of the 《$$プロトデビルン$$》...」

425:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$... You mean $$シビル$$ and the others...」

425:t_2:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$スピリチア$$... I hear it's the biological energy of humans that they needed in order to survive...」

425:t_2:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ゲペルニッチ$$, the leader of the $$プロトデビルン$$, in order to secure a steady supply of $$スピリチア$$...」

425:t_2:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...built a system that abducts humans, locks them up, and wrings $$スピリチア$$ out of them.」

425:t_2:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So that's the $$スピリチア$$ Farm Project...」

425:t_2:19.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The sight of these capsules lined up across the whole area... It closely resembles the $$スピリチア$$ Farm I saw in the documents.」

425:t_2:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As Captain $$ジェフリー$$ surmised, the capsules here appear to be meant for housing humans.」

425:t_2:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It's possible that $$サイデリアル$$ abducts people everywhere in order to use them in this system.」

425:t_2:23.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Incoming transmission from Major $$オズマ$$, who is commanding the detached unit.」

425:t_2:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This is Major $$オズマ・リー$$. We've found civilians captured by $$サイデリアル$$.」

425:t_2:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We managed to get some of them to talk, but the captives also include a fair number of people who were brought over from $$蒼の地球$$.」

425:t_2:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... From the way you put that, are many of the captives unable to talk?」

425:t_2:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Exactly. ...For the investigation, please send $F over here.」

425:t_2:35.en: ～ Inside $$ターミナル・ベース$$ Facility ～

425:t_2:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
「As you can see. They all have $$血塗られた眼$$, just like you.」

425:t_2:42.en:
$n
「I reacted when we got close to this base, but now...」

425:t_2:43.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is there anything you can tell?」

425:t_2:44.en:
$n
「I... I think the $$血塗られた眼$$ develops in people who came into contact with the $$テンシ$$ that caused a $$時空震動$$.」

425:t_2:45.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then these people also had contact with the $$テンシ$$...?」

425:t_2:47.en:
$n
「It's just that, from what I've heard, the symptoms of the people I know with $$血塗られた眼$$ gradually faded after $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was defeated.」

425:t_2:48.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But I hear you believe $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ are separate things.」

425:t_2:50.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ was certainly my enemy, but the image just never lines up with the $$テンシ$$ I saw during the $$時空震動$$ that took my father and my sister.」

425:t_2:51.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Judging by the situation, there's no doubt they were used in that system.」

425:t_2:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can find out what that is, we may learn something about the $$血塗られた眼$$ too.」

425:t_2:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...We can't leave them like this. Let's contact the Resistance in the area and ask them to take these people under their protection.」

425:t_2:54.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「First we need to confirm their numbers and, as far as possible, their identities.」

425:t_2:55.en:
$n
(What on earth is this...? What is happening here...)

425:t_2:59.en:
$n
「Why are you two here!? What on earth happened!?」

425:t_2:63.en:
$n
「Tell me anything, $$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$! If you don't...!」
